business_summary: Shentong Robot Education Group Company Limited, an investment holding company, provides robotics related education and training services in the People's Republic of China. It also operates artificial intelligence education platform; and leases office premises. The company was formerly known as China Communication Telecom Services Company Limited and changed its name to Shentong Robot Education Group Company Limited in September 2016. Shentong Robot Education Group Company Limited was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Central, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Shentong Robot Education Group Company Limited는 중화인민공화국에서 로봇 관련 교육 및 훈련 서비스를 제공합니다. 인공지능 교육 플랫폼도 운영하고 있습니다. 그리고 사무실을 임대합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 China Communication Telecom Services Company Limited로 알려져 있었으며 2016년 9월에 Shentong Robot Education Group Company Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. Shentong Robot Education Group Company Limited는 2002년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 센트럴에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
